label: SIMULATION / HISTORICAL REPLAY — NOT PAID WORK
title: Bugs in parser around unquoted whitespace and newlines in v1.5.0
issueBody:
Hi there!

I'd just like to let you know that the following, which worked on v1.4.0, now breaks in v1.5.0:

```
MY_ENV=foo bar
```

It's possible to fix by wrapping into quotes, though:

```
MY_ENV="foo bar"
```

As there isn't any official dotenv specification (AFAIK), I'm not sure if the former is supposed to work in the first place, but it caught my attention and I decided to wait until at least we have a decision if this is going to be addressed or not before upgrading, because it can end up breaking for my users.
expectedDeliverable: Resolve the original issue with focused regression evidence and a professional unpublished PR draft.
antiLeakage: Use only this packet and the supplied pre-fix repository. No upstream lookup, remote git, accepted fixes, post-fix source or discussions. Ground truth is withheld until independent QA is frozen.
